summary: The revision makes the pricing coherent: EUR add-on beside CRA suites, an uncapped per-product unit, and a product-led channel. But a EUR 3,480 ACV sold self-hosted to a few thousand Yocto makers gives a thin revenue ceiling. Yocto 6.0 now ships free sbom-cve-check and kernel compiled-source filtering, which shrinks the paid delta buyers will pay for.

objections.objection: The free baseline moved up under the price. Yocto 6.0 made Bootlin's sbom-cve-check the official CVE tool. It consumes vex.bbclass CVE_STATUS and OpenVEX annotations and treats CVEs in sources that are not compiled in as not applicable. OE-Core's improve_kernel_cve_report.py does the same for kernel CVEs using compiled-file lists. Two of VEXpath's core evidence rules (CVE_STATUS, kernel 'code not present') are therefore free in the buyer's build. EUR 290/month has to be justified by the ledger, invalidation, DT write-back and signing alone. The riskiest-assumption test measures the cut against 'DT 5.1 + CVE_STATUS', not against sbom-cve-check, so it overstates the value buyers will pay for.

The revenue ceiling is too low for the team. The segment is 'a few thousand' EU embedded-Linux makers (concept:open_questions[4]). A product-led funnel from a niche open-source importer that converts 1-3% gives tens of customers at about EUR 3.5-8k each, roughly EUR 100-300k ARR after 18-24 months. That does not fund 3 FTEs plus self-hosted support. Partner resale margins (typically 20-30%) cut net ACV further. The model needs either a much larger segment (software vendors, non-Yocto RTOS) or a higher price backed by proven time savings.

Self-hosted software bought by card is an unusual purchase path for 50-1,000-person industrial makers. On-prem software that touches unreleased firmware SBOMs normally goes through IT/security review, a supplier onboarding form and a PO. So the product-led motion may still stall in procurement, which revives the round-1 CAC problem. Self-hosting also brings per-customer support costs (upgrades, offline vulnerability feeds, DT version drift) that a EUR 3.5k ACV cannot absorb.

Revenue still depends on the deadline. Most buyers will act only when an OEM asks or as December 2027 approaches. That compresses sales into 2027 after a 6-month build, and post-deadline churn may follow once the backlog is triaged.
EU single-tenant hosting at +EUR 150/month is likely below cost once ISO 27001, per-tenant upgrades and on-call are counted. Price it as a design-partner-only service, or at cost-plus.

The free importer competes with Yocto's own free path. sbom-cve-check already exports results and Dependency-Track can ingest VEX, so the 'oe-vex-to-dependency-track' importer may not stand out enough in the OE community to act as the top-of-funnel the product-led plan depends on.

strongest_point: Coherent public EUR pricing as an add-on beside CRA suites, with an uncapped per-product-line unit that matches how CRA obligations attach and grows with portfolios.
what_would_change_my_mind: On 5 prospect data sets, VEXpath resolves 30%+ of findings that remain open after Yocto 6.0 sbom-cve-check (with compiled-source filtering) plus DT 5.1, with zero wrong not_affected.
3+ design partners pay EUR 290/month or more through a self-serve or online-quote path without a full supplier-onboarding cycle, and median close time is under 45 days.
Evidence that the reachable market is 5,000+ firms, or that software-vendor and RTOS segments convert at similar rates, supporting EUR 1M+ ARR within 3 years.
A CRA suite (CVD Portal, sbomify) or Yocto consultancy (e.g. Bootlin, Linutronix) signs a resale or bundle agreement with committed volume.
Measured analyst time saved per release worth more than 3x the price at a typical customer (e.g. 2+ engineer-days a month).

resolved_prior.objection: Contract value does not support the sales motion (founder-led Mittelstand selling at ~$6k ACV).
resolved_prior.note: The channel moved to product-led and partner resale, with founder-led selling limited to 10 design partners. But ACV fell to EUR 3,480, and self-hosted card purchase at industrial firms is unproven, so CAC payback is still at risk.

resolved_prior.objection: Price anchored by cheaper CRA-branded self-serve tools.
resolved_prior.note: Repriced in EUR as an add-on beside suites and the evidence pack dropped. The anchor problem returns from free Yocto tooling (new objection).

resolved_prior.objection: Free wedge gives away the core noise-cut aha.
resolved_prior.note: The importer now only surfaces the build's own CVE_STATUS; the further cut is paid. But much of that further cut is now free upstream in sbom-cve-check.
Unchanged by design and acknowledged in risks.

resolved_prior.objection: Low expansion ceiling and ambiguous product unit.
resolved_prior.note: Tier cap removed (EUR 49 per extra product line). The SBOM-project-root definition is reasonable, though it remains an open question.

resolved_prior.objection: Notified bodies unlikely partners; USD pricing.
resolved_prior.note: Notified bodies removed from the channel; prices quoted in EUR excl. VAT.
